BREAKTHROUGH: Ned identified that fear of public failure (not technical or product gaps) is why distribution never happens. Gifted kid pattern: identity built on 'I win without effort' — going public means people can watch you fail. Framing: 'Building is safe, nobody sees the terminal. Marketing means being judged.'

EVIDENCE THAT BREAKS THE PATTERN:
- Posted Pixel Office on LinkedIn March 24, got 15 reactions, commented: 'that was easier than expected, wasn't scary'
- Roy Lee method validated: Ned has BOTH components most lack — can build fast AND has marketing/content expertise
- His actual superpower: 'marketer who learned to build' = rare asymmetric advantage

ROY LEE INSIGHT APPLIED TO NED:
- He has 'the button' (content creation skill + build velocity)
- The only blocker was pressing it
- 115+ IQ + under 28 + brain-rotted + can build = perfect profile

IMPLICATIONS:
- Content-first distribution is not just strategy, it's the correct path
- CleanMyRoll (gallery app) + Pixel Office are natural YouTube content
- Each public post makes the next one easier
